title: Day In my Life as a Software Engineering Intern at Google

segments.text: What's up guys, my name is Jonathan.
I'm a software engineering intern here at Google, and this is kind of what the typical
day in my life looks like.
I usually get to the office kind of late, around 10am each day.
But I'm not slacking, it's because I get off work pretty late too.
In the morning, I usually take care of admin work, like responding to emails and chats,
and scheduling meetings as fast as possible.
Then I try to jump into a little bit of coding if I can.
I'll grab a bit of a snack and get back to work.
Each floor has a micro kitchen that's pretty stacked.
It has a variety of different snacks and also drinks, and as well as like coffee and tea.
This summer, I'm on the Borglet team, which basically means I'm doing internal infrastructure
work for Google.
Google's internal jobs run on millions of machines across their data centers, and our
job is to write the code that runs on each of those machines to handle all of Google's
complex workloads.
It's really challenging, complicated, complex, and often kind of frustrating, but really
rewarding when things work.
This is my first time doing infrastructure work, and it's been pretty hard but honestly
really, really fun and rewarding when things actually work.
Around noon, I'll grab lunch with my team, or with my intern friends, at one of the various
cafes.
